description.en: This synthetic example demonstrates service preferences and fictional household records. It is not a Diversity Visa form.

description.en: A fake preference shows how the wizard renders JSON-defined choices.

label.en: Show the optional example note field

description.en: A second schema-defined step demonstrates conditional fields.

help.en: Demo only. Do not enter real applicant or identity information.

description.en: This demonstration uses labels A, B, and C instead of names or dates of birth.

label.en: For this fictional example only, I understand that this demo cannot find other entries made outside this case.

ለዚህ ምናባዊ ምሳሌ ብቻ፣ ይህ ሙከራ ከዚህ ጉዳይ ውጭ ያሉ መዝገቦችን ማወቅ እንደማይችል ተረድቻለሁ።

help.en: The app checks duplicate sample labels in this list only. These labels are not identity matching.
